main_text.head: Cap. 26. De nominibus indeclinabilibus.
main_text.p: 1. Nomina literarum, ἄλφα, βῆτα, &c. (Legitur tamen σίγματα σιγμάτων) φἰ, ξἰ, π̃ι, μυ̃, νυ̃, ubi& v longa sunt.
2. Nomina numerorum, πέντε, quinque, ἓξ fex, ἑπτὰ septem, &c. deinceps ad ἑκατὸν centum.
main_text.l: ἄλφα pro ὁ ἄλφαρ pinguedo, unguen.
ὕφα pro ὁ ὕφασμα textura, tela.
ἑξφι pro ὁ ἑξφιμον plenum, alens.

page.notes: Greek accents and some letters in the scan are uncertain, especially in the lines of item 3 and the abbreviated words in item 1 (marked where doubtful in the text as printed). The lines of item 3 are set as list entries.
